text:
The man is likely to prevail. When the woman conveyed the house to him, he owned both the dominant and servient parcels, so the easement was extinguished by merger. Recording doesn't change that, and I disagree with the team note that it survives merger. His later warranty deed didn't create a new easement, and an implied easement fails because he never used the path while he owned both parcels.

CONFIDENCE: 85
